settings.visualStyle: Dunkirk May–June 1940 historical reenactment, muted grey-blue wartime film palette, 35mm field-camera grain, windy exposed beach, sea haze, smoke columns, wet uniforms, realistic British Expeditionary Force equipment, non-graphic danger, no modern objects.
settings.customProjectStructure: 15 connected scenes x 8 seconds. Embedded war-camera perspective following one fictional British infantryman through waiting, air attack, dunes, pier, boarding and withdrawal. No dialogue, narrator or intelligible commands. One primary action and one camera movement per scene.
settings.customVisualStyle: Windy 1940 evacuation film with imperfect handheld framing, wet sand, sea spray, grey light, aircraft threat and long visual lines of waiting soldiers.

movie.plotDetails: Fictional composite British infantryman used as continuity anchor; the episode does not claim to depict a specific surviving film reel.
movie.mainStoryPrompt: Create a continuous two-minute historical reenactment of the Dunkirk evacuation in 1940. Follow one fictional British infantryman from the exposed beach queue to an air-raid dash into dunes, a return to the line, the long mole, boarding under pressure, and a final look back from the water. No speeches or narration. Keep the rhythm exposed and anxious rather than constantly explosive. Preserve wet sand, smoke, sea haze, uniform wear and crowd density across scenes.
movie.storySummary: A British infantryman waits among long lines on Dunkirk beach. Aircraft force the men toward the dunes, but the queue reforms once the attack passes. He eventually joins the line along the mole, survives another attack, boards a rescue craft and looks back at thousands still waiting. The episode ends as boats move into grey water without triumphalism.
movie.storyTitle: WWII FRONTLINE FOOTAGE EP02 — Dunkirk 1940: Waiting on the Beach

scenes.title: Grey Shoreline
scenes.description: Long queues of soldiers stand on a windswept beach beneath a low grey sky.
scenes.actionDescription: The infantryman stands in line facing the sea while men stretch far into the background.
scenes.imageDescription: Dunkirk 1940, exposed sandy beach, long lines of British soldiers, smoke inland, distant small craft, muted grey-blue film look, same lead soldier in sandy wet uniform and steel helmet.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow lateral handheld move along the waiting line, ending on the lead soldier. Audio: surf, wind, boots in sand, distant aircraft, no speech.

scenes.title: Watching the Water
scenes.description: The soldier searches the sea for approaching rescue craft.
scenes.actionDescription: He raises one hand against the wind and scans offshore.
scenes.imageDescription: Same beach queue and uniform, soldier staring through sea haze toward small boats, smoke columns behind.
scenes.videoPrompt: Gentle push-in from shoulder height toward his gaze, then hold on the sea. Audio: wind, surf, faint engines, no voices.

scenes.title: Aircraft Overhead
scenes.description: The distant aircraft sound rapidly grows louder.
scenes.actionDescription: The infantryman looks sharply upward as the line begins to break.
scenes.imageDescription: British soldiers on open beach turning skyward, grey cloud, smoke and windblown sand, no visible gore.
scenes.videoPrompt: Quick tilt from the soldier to aircraft silhouettes overhead, then back to men reacting. Audio: engines swelling, wind, gear, no intelligible speech.

scenes.title: Run for the Dunes
scenes.description: The exposed queue scatters toward shallow dune cover.
scenes.actionDescription: The infantryman runs through soft sand toward the dunes with his rifle held low.
scenes.imageDescription: Windblown dunes, soldiers running from open beach, same lead soldier carrying wet sandy kit, aircraft threat above.
scenes.videoPrompt: Handheld running shot behind him through soft sand. Audio: heavy boots, aircraft, breathing, surf behind, no speech.

scenes.title: Sand Burst
scenes.description: A nearby impact throws sand high over the dune line.
scenes.actionDescription: He crouches low as sand showers over his helmet and shoulders.
scenes.imageDescription: Shallow dune cover, non-graphic blast of sand and smoke, lead soldier crouched with other British troops.
scenes.videoPrompt: One violent camera shake from the impact, then settle low behind the dune. Audio: blast, muffled ringing feel, sand, breathing. No speech.

scenes.title: Return to the Queue
scenes.description: The aircraft pass and the beach slowly reorganizes.
scenes.actionDescription: The infantryman walks back to the line brushing sand from his sleeve.
scenes.imageDescription: Same beach after attack, slightly more smoke, soldiers reforming orderly queues, lead soldier dustier and windblown.
scenes.videoPrompt: Medium handheld follow shot returning from dunes to the line. Audio: surf, wind, fading aircraft, scattered distant blasts.

scenes.title: Toward the Mole
scenes.description: A section of the line is directed toward the long narrow pier.
scenes.actionDescription: The infantryman joins a compact line walking toward the mole through sea spray.
scenes.imageDescription: Long mole stretching into grey water, soldiers moving in disciplined file, smoke and spray, period field gear.
scenes.videoPrompt: Forward tracking shot behind the line approaching the mole. Audio: surf, boots on wet boards, wind, engines offshore.

scenes.title: Long Walk Above the Sea
scenes.description: The queue advances along the exposed mole.
scenes.actionDescription: He walks in line with water visible on both sides.
scenes.imageDescription: Narrow pier crowded with British soldiers, grey water and smoke, no railings in places, same lead soldier mid-line.
scenes.videoPrompt: Shoulder-height forward track along the mole with gentle side sway from wind. Audio: boards, sea, gear, distant aircraft.

scenes.title: Boat Emerging Through Haze
scenes.description: A rescue craft becomes visible beside the pier.
scenes.actionDescription: The infantryman looks toward the approaching craft as the queue inches forward.
scenes.imageDescription: Rescue boat coming through sea haze beside crowded mole, soldiers waiting, smoke beyond beach.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow pan from the soldier to the approaching boat and hold. Audio: engine, waves against pier, wind.

scenes.title: Attack on the Pier
scenes.description: Aircraft noise returns before boarding is complete.
scenes.actionDescription: The infantryman drops flat with others on the pier and grips the wet boards.
scenes.imageDescription: Crowded pier under air-raid pressure, soldiers flattened, water below, spray and smoke, non-graphic action.
scenes.videoPrompt: Tense low handheld hold from board level with one quick sky glance. Audio: aircraft pass, distant blast, boards creak, breath.

scenes.title: Boarding
scenes.description: The line starts moving again and the infantryman reaches the craft.
scenes.actionDescription: He steps carefully down from the mole into the moving boat while another soldier steadies him.
scenes.imageDescription: Close practical boarding moment, wet boots, pier edge, packed rescue craft, same uniform and gear.
scenes.videoPrompt: Close follow shot of one careful step from pier to boat. Audio: engine, hull knock, water slap, gear clink.

scenes.title: Looking Back
scenes.description: From the boat, the infantryman sees the beach still filled with waiting troops.
scenes.actionDescription: He turns at the rail and looks back toward shore.
scenes.imageDescription: Sea-level view toward crowded Dunkirk beach, long lines still waiting, smoke inland, soldier foreground profile.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow turn from cramped boat interior to beach view. Audio: engine, waves, wind, distant battle.

scenes.title: No Celebration
scenes.description: The rescued men sit packed together, soaked and exhausted.
scenes.actionDescription: The infantryman lowers his head and grips a wet railing with both hands.
scenes.imageDescription: Tired British soldiers packed on small craft, wet helmets and uniforms, no cheering, grey water around them.
scenes.videoPrompt: Quiet close shot with gentle boat motion. Audio: engine throb, water, slow breathing, no speech.

scenes.title: Beach Receding
scenes.description: Dunkirk shrinks behind the boat but smoke still rises over the shore.
scenes.actionDescription: The infantryman remains at the side as the shoreline recedes.
scenes.imageDescription: Boat moving away through grey water, soldier at rail, distant smoky beach and tiny queues still visible.
scenes.videoPrompt: Rear-facing moving shot toward the receding beach. Audio: engine, sea, wind, battle fading with distance.

scenes.title: Across the Grey Water
scenes.description: Several small craft move away from the coast beneath the overcast sky.
scenes.actionDescription: The lead soldier becomes one figure among many aboard the departing craft.
scenes.imageDescription: Wide vertical view of evacuation boats crossing grey sea, distant Dunkirk smoke, subdued historical film texture, no triumphal imagery.
scenes.videoPrompt: Wide steady closing shot from slightly aft, allowing boats and shore to separate in depth. Audio: engine wash, waves, wind, very low restrained score tail.

continuity.continuityRules: Keep the same face, helmet, rifle and uniform across all scenes. Sand and dampness increase after the air-raid sequence and remain through boarding.
